newsitem.title: UK: Chesterfield says to buy Albion Property.
newsitem.headline: Chesterfield says to buy Albion Property.

text.p: Chesterfield Properties Plc said on Monday that it planned to buy Albion Property Investments Ltd for 21.9 million stg.
It also said in a statement that it planned to issue 4,018,032 ordinary shares at 545p and 2,009,014 warrants at a subscription price of 700p.
Chesterfield said that Albion chief executive Robert Maxted, who founded Albion in 1995, will become Chesterfield's chief executive.

It also said that the acquisition will enhance earnings per share and added that it is examining ways in which the group's entertainment interests can be separated to concentrate resources on property activities.
Albion's property portfolio produces an estimated net rental income of 11.4 million stg per annum and is valued at 110 million stg.
